name: Preparation for Ceremony

angles.text: As a tauren, you know that natural headdresses are bound to honor and rites of passage before the high chieftain. Helping make such regalia shows the tribes’ shared pride and spirit.
As a member of the Horde, you honor the customs of your tauren allies atop Thunder Bluff’s mesas when you help with their ceremonial duties.

faq.answer: The ceremony marks a tauren appearing before Chief Cairne Bloodhoof. His sibling is making a headdress from tanned leather and vibrant feathers for the occasion.
faq.q: What ceremony is being prepared for?

faq.answer: Chief Cairne Bloodhoof leads the united tauren tribes from Thunder Bluff. Standing before him is an honor for any tauren.

aliases: why do we need harpy feathers
faq.answer: The headdress needs feathers of a particular size and color. Its design calls for azure and bronze plumage while the leather straps are tanned.
faq.q: Why are harpy feathers needed for the headdress?

aliases: where are azure and bronze feathers
faq.answer: The harpies live in rugged lands north and northwest of Thunder Bluff, in Mulgore.

Harpies are vicious, avian-humanoid creatures that nest in Mulgore’s rocky crags. They threaten travelers and the tribes, while their large, colorful plumage provides material for ceremonial ornaments.
faq.q: What role do harpies play in Mulgore?

faq.answer: Eyahn Eagletalon tans the leather straps and makes the headdress for his brother, who is preparing to appear before the chieftain.
faq.q: Who is crafting the ceremonial headdress?

sections.body: Among the tauren, standing before Chief Cairne Bloodhoof brings pride and reverence. Families honor the occasion by preparing proper attire. The traditional headdress is made from treated leather and symbolic plumage, with each part chosen to show dignity and respect before the leader of the united tribes.
sections.title: Honoring the Chieftain

sections.body: A ceremonial headdress needs a leather band and feathers for its crown. While the leather straps are tanned, long, pristine feathers must be gathered. Harpies roost in the craggy hills north and northwest of Thunder Bluff, so you must venture into their hostile nests to find feathers of the needed size and color.
sections.title: Feathers of the Crags

summary: Eyahn Eagletalon is making a headdress for his brother, who soon stands before Chief Cairne Bloodhoof. He asks you to gather the vibrant feathers from harpies beyond Thunder Bluff while he tans the leather bands.
